blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Two suspected drug pushers were arrested in separate operations in Quezon province on Monday, police said. Authorities seized suspected shabu (crystal meth) valued at more than P360,000 and two unlicensed firearms. Col. Romulo Albacea, Quezon police chief, in a report, said operatives of the Police Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit, armed with a search warrant, raided the house of a 56-year-old resort caretaker who is allegedly a high-value target in Barangay Poblacion Uno at Real town at around 6:30 p.m. READ: Quezon cops seize P3M worth of shabu from high-value trafficker Police said the suspect was allegedly caught with […]...
